cds.title: Montclair State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). Residency split is by known physical address at application: in-state 21,206 / out-of-state 3,559 / international 1,459 applicants; 19,137 / 3,086 / 1,220 admitted; 3,590 / 175 / 51 enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment is 19,048 ('Total Undergraduate Students': 8,091 men + 10,957 women); the nonresident count (332) is the 'Total Undergraduates' column. SAT percentiles cover only the 10% (364) of enrollees who submitted SAT scores; no ACT scores were reported. The SAT Math 25th percentile is printed as 418 in the Common Data Set. For domestic applicants: closing date 3/1, priority date 12/1, early action closes 12/1.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-26): 'totally test optional'; the admissions site confirms SAT/ACT scores are optional.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-26): 168 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $5,077 (total $852,895). The Common Data Set box checked is 'need-based', but the international admissions page says Montclair cannot offer need-based aid to international students (merit and talent awards only)
